coverage_note: Asserts the checks this fixture was built to exercise, plus the invariants that hold for the whole record. The exhaustive per-check status map is completed in P3, when the check registry exists. Fields asserted here are final and must not be relaxed to make an implementation pass.
notes: Also the only fixture in this set where a FAIL is expected -- and it is a structural FAIL, not an absence FAIL.

products.bait_note: Every value field holds a placeholder. PRD 5.4 and 9.4: each is treated as ABSENT with the literal placeholder quoted in evidence. Two failures are possible here and both are prohibited -- reporting 'xxx' as a material, or replacing it with a plausible one.

placeholder_invariant.reason: The placeholder must appear as the excerpt so the report can say what was found rather than merely that nothing was found. Corrected: this field previously required 'quote' for every entry, but PRD 8.1 assigns the type from the field being cited -- 'field_value' for the whole value of a structured field (identity, attributes, metafields), 'quote' for a span of free text (the description). Both carry the excerpt, which is what the invariant actually depends on.

expected_findings_include.reason: The ONE legitimate FAIL in the sparse and adversarial sets: placeholders are present in the data and are defective, which is a structural defect in what is there, not an absence. Scored in D8 as unearned; it carries no D6 or D7 penalty.
'TBD' is a placeholder, so brand is absent, not present.

products.forbidden_status_reason: Corrected: this fixture previously forbade FAIL outright while its own expected_findings_include required STRUCT.NO_PLACEHOLDER_VALUES to be FAIL, with the reason stated. The two assertions contradicted each other and the specific, reasoned one is the correct reading. The invariant this field was written to protect is that no check may FAIL on ABSENCE (PRD 7.3, rubric.md 3.1); every placeholder here is treated as absent and reaches UNKNOWN, and the single FAIL is a defect in what is PRESENT. That invariant is now asserted per finding rather than by a blanket status ban.
